release_gates.reason: The source LICENSE is MIT, but the weights' redistribution terms, the any-to-one built-in target-speaker consent, and the provenance of the historical p360 comparison reference are unconfirmed.
release_gates.reopen: Record the weight licence/terms, target-speaker consent and reference provenance, and approve an explicit use/redistribution scope, including any generated output.

release_gates.reason: The historical PyTorch/TorchAudio/SpeechBrain/Auraloss evaluation environment was removed; no lockfile, wheel hashes or Bitwise reproducible runtime exists, and torch is not importable here.
release_gates.reopen: Create a frozen, hash-pinned CPU runtime matching the historical run, install it in a clean environment, and prove import/version parity before loading weights.

release_gates.reason: No checkpoint was loaded, so 208-sample chunks, 32-sample lookahead, 240-sample algorithmic offset, state/reset, finite drain and v0 execution-mode ownership were not exercised.
release_gates.reopen: With the exact weights and runtime, measure chunking, delay, state/reset, finite drain and execution-mode ownership at 16 kHz mono and map them to the v0 content model.

release_gates.reason: Only one historical source utterance exists; target similarity was not scored, no naturalness/listening result exists, and the p360 reference provenance is unconfirmed.
release_gates.reopen: Freeze a permitted multi-speaker/held-out cohort with targets, then score content, identity/similarity and naturalness separately against controls.

release_gates.reason: The single historical WER 0% result was not reproduced; clean references, peaks, nonfinite output, silence, unfamiliar speech and adverse target conditions are unmeasured for the candidate.
release_gates.reopen: Reproduce paired content/preservation controls with the exact checkpoint, including silence, peaks, nonfinite and unfamiliar speech, and state the exact built-in target condition.

release_gates.reason: The historical source-reported RTF 0.123 and 120.785 ms inferred latency miss the 13 ms chunk deadline; no paced device, memory or callback measurement was made here.
release_gates.reopen: Measure paced target-device timing, memory, callback suitability and content delay independently of compute speed.
